conversation_id.description: The unique identifier of the conversation to append the event to.

data.description: The event payload. Its shape is defined by the registered event type and is validated against that type before the event is appended.

type.description: The event type to append. Must be a custom event type registered by a plugin; built-in timeline event types are rejected.

conversation_id.description: The ID of the conversation the event was appended to.

created_at.description: The ISO timestamp assigned to the event by the server.

event_id.description: The server-assigned ID of the appended event.

type.description: The type of the appended event.
